Flux LoRA · caption study

Your captions vs auto-captions

The same 162 images, captioned two ways. Yours (used for the released model) are short and lock a consistent style phrase to the trigger word. Auto (LLaVA-13B, the trainer's default when you don't supply captions) writes a long per-image description of content and color — but never reinforces a single style. For style training, the consistent short caption is usually the stronger choice; the auto route trades style-consistency for richer content grounding.
